question: How do we protect children from apps designed to keep them scrolling and chatting longer?
reflection: Rules that put children's wellbeing before screen time can push technology makers to design for healthy habits.

sources.subject: Democrats want Congress back for AI safety
OpenAI: trim bloated prompts, ElevenLabs rival ships free voice clon

one_line: California moved to limit addictive design and companion chatbots for minors, while builders were told that smarter models need shorter instructions.

top_stories.title: California curbs addictive feeds and companion chatbots for minors
top_stories.what: New California laws reportedly ban autoplay and personalised feeds for under-16s and require risk checks, independent audits and usage limits for companion chatbots.
top_stories.why: Rules built on how habits form give behavioural researchers a clear role in testing which design features harm young users.

top_stories.title: OpenAI says less prompting works better
top_stories.what: OpenAI advises builders to cut long instructions written for older models, since its newer Astra model reportedly does better with short, precise guidance and a clear definition of done.
top_stories.why: Teams that built heavy prompt libraries may get better and cheaper results by simplifying them.

top_stories.title: Free voice cloning tool covers hundreds of languages
top_stories.what: A solo developer released VoiceStudio, an open-source app that runs on a local computer and reportedly clones voices and dubs video into 646 languages.
top_stories.why: Cheap local dubbing can widen access to Arabic content, but it also makes voice fakes easier to produce.

saudi_lens.text: California's child-safety rules for chatbots offer a reference point as Saudi regulators and schools weigh how young people should use AI companions.
Local voice and dubbing tools could help produce Arabic educational content at low cost, provided consent for voice use is respected.

idea.title: Youth app design audit
idea.pitch: A behavioural audit that scores consumer apps and chatbots on features linked to compulsive use among teenagers.
idea.first_step: List the features named in the California package and turn them into a simple scoring sheet.

idea_kids.title: My healthy screen day planner
idea_kids.pitch: A paper planner where children draw their day and choose where screen time fits alongside family, prayer, play and sleep.
idea_kids.first_step: Design one printable day wheel with eight blank sections and test it with a small group of parents.

terms.definition: An AI chat app designed to act like a friend or partner and keep an ongoing personal conversation.
Writing and refining the instructions given to an AI model to get better results.
Fake audio, video or images made with AI to look or sound like a real person.

concepts.summary: Lawmakers add safety rules for chatbots that act as companions to young users.
Smarter models need shorter, clearer prompts rather than heavy step-by-step guidance.
Free local voice cloning tools make synthetic voices easier to create.
